key_insight: PLADOS enables decentralized optimization on the Stiefel manifold with a parameter-free, retraction-free landing scheme that achieves stable consensus and linear speedup.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical distributed optimization method for machine learning and signal processing settings where orthogonality-constrained models must be trained across networks.
method: Local stochastic gradient updates on each node
Single communication step per iteration, without retraction
Penalty-only consensus mechanism with a restricted secant inequality to ensure local contraction
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an asymptotic convergence rate of O(σ/√(nbK) + (nξ²)^(1/3)/K^(2/3)) and experiments showing stability across stepsizes and networks, time efficiency, and linear speedup.
watch_item: The guarantees are asymptotic and rely on local contraction assumptions, so performance may depend on problem structure, heterogeneity, and network conditions.
paper_title: PLADOS: A Parameter-free Landing Algorithm for Decentralized Optimization on the Stiefel Manifold
